# Best slim Qi2 / MagSafe power banks for iPhone 17

**Best overall slim pick: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim)**
- It's 0.34" thick and 4.3 oz, with 5,000mAh and Qi2 15W wireless charging. Anker's page calls it the best fit for the iPhone 17 series.
- 9to5Mac says it's the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery and runs cooler than the competition.
- It's $54.99 (Anker was running a $5 auto-applied discount when the page was captured).
- [Buy at Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank)

**Best slim with more capacity and speed: INIU SnapGo Air (10,000mAh, 25W Qi2.2)**
- Your iPhone 17 supports 25W Qi2.2, which this bank can use. Slower 15W banks won't take advantage of that.
- It's 0.5" thick and about 195g, and Macworld lists it as an equal-slimmest 10K bank. It has 45W wired output and a built-in lanyard-style USB-C cable.
- Android Central lists it at $42.99 on Amazon or $44.99 from INIU, which is good value.
- Reviews: [Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge) and [Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html) (both have purchase links)

**Thinnest and lightest: Baseus Picogo Air AM71 (5,000mAh)**
- Android Central found it the thinnest and lightest of the group at 0.27" and 104g.
- The catch is that its wireless speed is only 7.5W, not 15W Qi2. It's also about $52.99 on Amazon, so you pay a similar price for slower charging.
- It suits you only if pocket thickness matters more than charging speed.
- [Android Central review](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)

**Budget slim option: ReelCharge ReelSafe (5,000mAh)**
- It has a semi-solid-state battery and 15W wireless charging, and is 0.35" thick and 119g.
- It's the cheapest of the group at $49.99.
- [Android Central review](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)

## Which should you choose?
- **Slimmest at full Qi2 speed:** the Anker Nano 5K.
- **Most charge for the money, still fairly slim:** the INIU SnapGo Air. A 10K bank can charge an iPhone close to twice, while 5K banks typically reach about 60-75%.
- **Avoid:** the LISEN P601 shows up in search results, but its page is a wholesale (MOQ 100) listing, not a consumer retail page.

Prices change often, so check the final price at checkout. A magnetic charger also needs a MagSafe/Qi2-compatible case. Anker notes that thick or non-magnetic cases can interfere.
